name: My Best Friends’ Girlfriends
source:
Would I fuck my best friends’ girlfriends? The easy answer is that I wouldn’t. But what if those girls were bored with their boyfriends, and I’m the only one who truly understands them? This weekend, I’ll be able to make up my mind.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4626550/My_Best_Friends_Girlfriends/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我会去睡死党们的女朋友吗？不假思索的回答当然是“绝不”。可如果那些女孩早就对自己的男友感到厌倦，而我又是唯一真正懂她们的人呢？这个周末，我就能拿定主意了。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4626550/My_Best_Friends_Girlfriends/]Steam[/url]]
